cases.question: Can I withdraw for free at any time?

response.message:
Each cash value withdrawal is currently subject to a charge of US$25 / HK$200 / MOP200 per transaction [1][2].

The withdrawal charge is waived only when using the automatic periodic withdrawal option, which is applicable only if the policy has been in force for at least 10 years [2][3].

You can withdraw a portion of the Cash Value at any time, but the per-withdrawal fee applies unless the periodic withdrawal conditions are met [4][1].

The current fee schedule is not guaranteed and is subject to change at the insurer's discretion with one month's written notice [3].

If you surrender the policy or decrease the Basic Sum Insured within the first 14 years from the Policy Date or from the effective date of each increase in Basic Sum Insured, a surrender charge also applies, determined by gender, issue age, smoking habit, risk class, and years in effect [1].

cases.question: What are the cooling-off rights?

response.message:
You have 21 calendar days to return the policy if you are not satisfied with it [1].

The 21-day period starts from the earlier of: (a) delivery of the Policy to you, or (b) delivery of a Notice stating that the Policy is available for collection and the expiry date of the cooling-off period [1].

To exercise this right, you must return the Policy under a signed covering letter to the insurer at the address specified in the brochure [1].

Upon receipt of your written request, the insurer will cancel the Policy and refund all premiums and the levy you paid (the levy applies to Hong Kong only), without any interest [1].

No refund will be made if a benefit payment has already been made, is to be made, or is impending [1].

citations.excerpt: Cooling-off Period and Right of Cancellation If you are not satisfied with the Policy, you may return it under a signed covering letter to us (Hong Kong: 27/F, YF Life Tower, 33 Lockhart Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong / Macau: Avenida Doutor Mario Soares No. 320, Finance and IT Center of Macau, 8 Andar A, Macau) within 21 calendar days after the delivery of the Policy or delivery of the Notice (which states that the Policy is available for collection and the expiry date of the cooling-off period) to you or your representative, whichever is earlier. We will cancel the Policy upon receipt of your written request and refund all premiums and the levy you paid (applicable to Hong Kong only), without any interest. No refund can be made if a benefit payment has been made, is to be made or impending.
